prompts.title: Season plan offer
prompts.summary: A season plan with a clear price, what's included and the signup post.
prompts.prompt: Write a season plan for [business]: [mows] mows from [month] to [month], plus [extras]. Price by lot size [ ]. Payment options [ ]. Then the signup post, a door hanger (40 words at most) and a reminder post two weeks later.
prompts.use: Post it in March, before the first mow.

prompts.title: Rain day texts
prompts.summary: Texts for a rain delay, a reschedule and a skipped week.
prompts.prompt: Write short texts for [business]: rain delay today (new day [ ]), we're running a day behind all week, and skipping this week because of drought or heat. Under 30 words.
prompts.use: Send them to the whole route from your phone or app.

prompts.title: Price by lot size
prompts.summary: Prices weekly and biweekly mowing by lot size, with drive time.
prompts.prompt: Price mowing for [business]. Target per hour [$] per crew member, crew size [ ], minutes per lot size: small [ ], medium [ ], large [ ], drive time between yards [min]. Give weekly and biweekly prices and a minimum.

notes: Weed, grub, insect and disease treatments for hire need your state's pesticide applicator license, and some states and cities limit fertilizer. Offer them only if you hold the license.
